criteria.evidence: Gate evidence is in the PR body (verify-local BUILD SUCCESSFUL); not re-run by this read-only review. No residual reference to a deleted symbol found by grep across app, core and sibling feature modules.
git ls-files feature/tailor/impl/src/test/screenshots prints 0; all listed packages and files are deleted; exported/ExportedFileStore.kt is kept.

Kept main files and the seven named tests exist. But document/ReviewContinuationTest.kt and document/ReviewExportConsistencyTest.kt (not named in c3 and not in the issue's delete scope) were deleted though they exercise surviving buildTailorUiState and ResumeDocumentAssembler. See finding.

TailorViewModelTest diff removes only onRegenerate_* (7 cases incl. the early recordsTheRegeneration case), uiState_marksOffline..., FixedTailor/NoViolationGuard helpers and now-unused imports. Surviving: uiState_startsLoading, onAccept, onKeepOriginal, onUndo, nextOpenChange, onEditByHand, report cases, scenario cases. core/domain untouched; UpdateBulletDecisionUseCaseTest, TailorResumeUseCaseTest, OfflineFabricationGuardTest exist and are unchanged (git diff core is empty). The fabrication guard was never asserted in TailorViewModelTest, so I.1 coverage is not weakened.

TailorViewModel constructor has no RegenerateSectionUseCase or ConnectivityMonitor; regenerateFailures channel, onRegenerate and online combine input removed; grep ConnectivityMonitor/isOffline/regenerationsUsed in feature/tailor/impl/src is empty.
TailorEntryProvider.kt has nine entries each using BasicText(key.javaClass.simpleName), signature tailorEntry(navigator: Navigator) kept, no material3 import; feature/tailor/api not in the diff.
lint-baseline.xml diff is a single removed PluralsCandidate issue; no additions. No tools:ignore added.
strings_*.xml for deleted features removed; no code references to removed resources found (strings.xml itself reviewed by Reviewer B).
PR body reports verify-local.sh green; no new comments in added lines (grep of added lines for // is empty).

findings.rule: review-checklist 5 (pregate justifies every deleted test); issue 257 keeps document/** and TailorUiState* for later waves; 257-c3
findings.trigger: document/ReviewExportConsistencyTest.kt asserted that the entries built by buildTailorUiState (what the user reviews) equal the entries ResumeDocumentAssembler emits (what is exported), including a late USER_STATED fact; document/ReviewContinuationTest.kt asserted continuation merging in the same review-vs-export path. Both were deleted with the pregate reason 'review screen ... subject deleted', but their subjects (buildTailorUiState, ResumeDocumentAssembler, both kept) survive. After this PR a drift between the reviewed and exported resume (e.g. a dropped continuation or fact) passes the whole suite.
findings.proof: Restore both tests minus the isOffline and regenerationsUsed arguments of TailorInputs; they should pass unchanged otherwise.
